# Saw Win Phay (WINPHAY)

> Personal portfolio website of Saw Win Phay (`https://winphay.celestrionx.com`) — systems engineering, autonomous agent tooling, procedural WebGL graphics, and mini-blog under CelestrionX.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Agent Onboarding Contract](https://winphay.celestrionx.com/agents.md): Instructions for AI coding agents and MCP clients inspecting this portfolio.
- [Homepage Markdown Mirror](https://winphay.celestrionx.com/index.md): Pure Markdown representation of the primary website and mini-blog index.
- [Full Technical Profile](https://winphay.celestrionx.com/llms-full.txt): Extended system architecture notes, project capabilities, and blog catalog.
- [Mini-Blog JSON Index](https://winphay.celestrionx.com/posts/index.json): Structured metadata for all published blog entries.

## Featured Open-Source Systems

- [Vessel (v0.6.0)](https://github.com/WinPhay/vessel): Local, time-traveling container sandbox engine for autonomous AI coding agents with filesystem checkpoints, Myers delta diffs, DLP redaction, git worktree isolation, and native stdio MCP tools.
- [Auralis (v0.2.1)](https://github.com/Celestrionx/auralis): Headless audio graph compiler and auditory telemetry engine in pure Rust with built-in stdio MCP server and Hann FFT acoustic feedback.
- [StellarPub](https://stellarpub.celestrionx.com): Burmese digital literature platform (`burmese-stories`) and OTA Godot 4 `.pck` story distribution.
